content: Sapengki ngihl tikitik kin kameleilei lingeringer, ahpw ngihl kehlail kin kamwakidada.
Ni aramas loalokong men eh kin lokaia, e kin kalinganahda loalokong, ahpw me pweipwei men kin kapwiliwei lokaia mwahl.
KAUN-O ketin mwahngih dahme kin wiawi wasa koaros; e kin ketin mwasamwasahn kitail ma kitail kin wia me mwahu de me suwed.
Lokaia kadek kin kahrehda mour, ahpw lokaia lemei kin kauwehla mohngiong en aramas.
Tiahk en pweipwei ma ke mwamwahliki padahk en omw pahpa; ahpw tiahk en loalokong ma ke ale eh kapwung.
Aramas pwung kan kin nekinekid ar dipwisou kan, ahpw me suwed akan kin katiasang ar dipwisou kan ni ahnsoun kahpwal.
Me loalokong kan kin kaparapeseng loalokong, ahpw me pweipwei kan, soh.
KAUN-O kin ketin kupwurperenki en aramas mwahu kan ar kapakap, ahpw e kin ketin kalahdeki meirong kan me aramas suwed kan kin wiahiong.
KAUN-O kin ketin kalahdeki wiewiahn aramas suwed; ahpw kin ketin kupwur limpoak ong me kin wia me pwung.
Ma ke wiahda me sapwung, ke pahn ale lokolok laud; ke pahn mehla ma ke kahng ale kopwungpomw.
Nan wasahn me melahr akan kin sansalohng KAUN-O; eri, ia duwen aramas emen eh kak karirihasang KAUN-O eh lamalam akan?
Aramas lemei sohte kin men ale kopwungparail; re sohte mwahn kin ale kaweid sang me loalokong kan.
Ni aramas ar kin peren, re kin kouruhr, ahpw ni ar kin nsensuwed, re kin seren pahtou.
Aramas loalokong kin men wehwehkihla, ahpw me pweipwei kin itarki ar soaloalokong.
Mour en aramas semwehmwe me apwal ahnsou koaros, ahpw aramas nsenamwahu kin pereperenki ar mour ahnsou koaros.
Semwehmwe oh lemmwiki KAUN-O mwahu sang kepwehpwe oh mihmi nan apwal laud.
Tungoale tehntuhke rehn aramas me ke poakepoake mwahusang tungoale uduk iou wasa me kailok mie.
Aramas me kin mwadang lingeringer kin kahrehda akamai, ahpw kanengamah kin kahrehda popohl.
Ma ke pohnkahke ke pahn diar apwal wasa koaros, ahpw ma ke mehlel, ke sohte pahn lelohng apwal.
Pwutak loalokong men kin kahrehiong seme en peren. Pwutak pweipwei me kin mwamwahliki ine.
Aramas pweipwei kin perenki ar tiahk en pweipwei, ahpw me kupwurokong kin wia dahme pwung.
Ale kaweid koaros uwen me ke kak, ke ahpw pahn pweida, pwe ma soh, ke pahn pwupwudi.
Meid kaperen diar mahsen pwung ni ahnsou me konehng!
Aramas kupwurokong kin keid ni ahl me ukadalahng mour, ahpw kaidehn ahl me ukedilahng mehla.
KAUN-O pahn ketin kamwomwala imwen me aklapalap akan, ahpw e pahn ketin sinsile imwen liohdi kan.
KAUN-O kin ketin kalahdeki lamalam suwed, ahpw e kin ketin kupwurperenki lokaia kadek.
Ma ke pahn song en kalaudehla omw pai ni widing, ke pahn kahrehiong omw peneinei nan apwal. Dehr ale pweipwei sapwung, ke ahpw pahn mour werei.
Aramas mwahu kin medemedewe mwohn ar pahn kin wia ar pasapeng. Aramas suwed kin mwadangete sapeng, ahpw ar pasapeng kin kahrehda kahpwal.
Ni aramas mwahu eh kin kapakap, KAUN-O kin ketin karonge, ahpw e sohte kin ketin tehk irail kan me kin wia me suwed.
Mesen kouruhr kin kaperenda nan kapehdomw, oh rohng mwahu kin kaperenihiukada mehlel.
Ma ke kanahieng rong kopwungpomw kan, eri, ke me loalokong.
Ma ke kahng padahngki mehkot, ke pahn pein kauweiukala. Ma ke pahn rong kapwungpomw, ke pahn loalokongla.
Lemmwiki KAUN-O iei kaiahn mwahu ehu. Ke pahn karakarahkala mwohn omw pahn kak ale wahu.
